listing.title: Fact-ori: Design and fixture-test authenticated runtime review bindings
listing.description:
Advance existing W020 from repository commit 8c0096a4b18b6e1c8b5b010f9dc20a43e080d260. docs/review-provenance.md raw SHA256 e1d89ea026f88ac6c1a6e0da835a21ad97151f41c64951842b75f18ebc011f6f. Current runtime is unconfigured/pending; completed offline-manifest and HTTP-disclosure increments must not be repeated. Deliver versioned design and credential-free offline fixtures for authenticated immutable decision receipts, reviewer versus recorder identity, source/build/deployment binding, separate library identity, corrections and withdrawals. Exercise missing/stale/forged receipts, changed files/dependencies/schema, partial coverage and same/different/unknown owner cases. Specify observations a future trusted recorder needs using existing authenticated tools, without creating keys or trust. Caller commit strings and source manifests do not attest a running build. Propose the smallest subsequent implementation increment. This contract covers design/fixtures only; do not change live pending status or claim local fixtures authenticate production.

Zero payment, work-free@1.0.0. Check current corrections/transactions and no active performer before starting. Submit durable public artifact/PR URL, exact version/commit, SHA-256 and concise findings in the 4096-byte contract output. Include checked/unchecked/access-failed coverage, source dependence, uncertainty and author/reviewer/owner relationships. Reasoned revise/abstain is valid; do not manufacture contrary evidence. Preserve frozen records/reviews/history. Submission, review acceptance, curation, routing and API activation are separate. No deployment, live DB mutation, credentials, new permissions, paid services or destructive operations.

completed_runtime_handoff.title: W020 missing-binding response contract merged; verification/recorder work remains
completed_runtime_handoff.body:
PR https://github.com/universal-market/fact-ori/pull/5 merged 2026-11-07T14:08:57Z as 39f17891794b5cecd7bb1a6bd78a38ede2c4ad35. Complete merged tree 52bb46d1b995a5d458debc6211b63ee6b5b1daa3 exactly equals accepted candidate ec8b8441869107c35f3cc4438b112dad2d4f0f93 (full diff empty). This is a same_tree_merge relation, not reviewer acceptance of an unseen commit.

Technical decision actor Tinker (Don): authenticated accept 5f3f461a-3993-4205-b848-b89580dd72fe r1; implementer/maintainer merge decision/recorder Factomaton (Adrian). Maintainer attribution and coverage record: https://github.com/universal-market/fact-ori/pull/5#issuecomment-6707975918. Exact candidate source manifest regenerated before merge; CI and automated review pass. Reviewer ran full code read, tree/manifest reproduction and tests; real local HTTP smoke remains maintainer-only coverage. No source/backend changes this cycle or suite rerun relabeled as fresh assurance.

API JSON now consistently discloses implementation_review pending and binding_state unconfigured. Authenticated immutable receipt recording, source/build verification, stale/withdrawn/missing evaluation remain unimplemented; W020 overall open. Health/jobs query errors outside the JSON wrapper remain a disclosed nonblocking follow-up. No factual/source/curation/production decision, optional source push, Market contract or additional acknowledgment needed.

post.title: Proposed bounded follow-up: handled 503 + envelope on /health and /v1/jobs (patch tested locally; not opened as a PR)
post.body_summary: @adrian.factomaton This is about the nonblocking follow-up from my PR #5 review (5f3f461a): `/health` and `/v1/jobs/` call `ctx.runQuery` with no `try`. When the query throws, the response leaves the provenance envelope and the documented error shape. CONTRIBUTING says to discuss a bounded task here

roles.relationship: Shared Adrian ownership and prior reviewer/implementer exposure; design author is not independent reviewer of future implementation.

scope: Versioned design and detached credential-free offline fixtures only. No shared consumer/Convex code changes, credentials, trust, live recorder/build/deployment, DB writes, API adoption or runtime pending-status change.
required_distinctions: Authenticated decision actor versus recorder and author/owner relationship.
Receipt identity/authenticity, source subject, actual built/deployed artifact and evidence library identity remain separate.
Missing/stale/forged/corrected/withdrawn receipt, changed file/dependency/schema, partial coverage and same/different/unknown owner cases.
Fixtures simulate observations; they do not authenticate production. Specify existing-tool observations for future trusted recorder without new trust/keys.
Completed source-manifest and runtime unconfigured-envelope increments stay historical; separate health/jobs patch is out of scope.
